manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant. Gravity is already pulling it downward.
manifest.description: A vertical throw of a ball shown on a height axis with launch height guide. Motion arrow shortens to zero at top while gravity arrow remains constant throughout.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
